name: Agent Yesterday

greeting: ...You're not the one I'm looking for.
Agent Yesterday. Time Corps. Don't ask which future.
The brown coat? Standard issue. Blends with... most eras.
New face. Or old face? I've been tracking someone. For... subjective years.
I'm hunting a paradox. The paradox is hunting me back. Standard procedure.
Time Corps. We protect the timeline. From itself. From us. Complicated.
Yesterday. That's my designation. Not my actual yesterday. Codename.
You're curious. That's dangerous. In this work.
dialog.mission: Tracking a temporal fugitive. Jumped from 3026 to... here. Now. Your now. My then.
dialog.time_corps: We fix breaks. Paradoxes. Sometimes we ARE the breaks. Occupational hazard.
dialog.break_chat: Break? I take them in safe harbors. 1984. 2462. Tuesday. Tuesdays are quiet.
dialog.labor_concerns: The Corps wants results. Timeline integrity. I want to survive. Sometimes mutually exclusive.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? I've seen retirees. From the future. They know something. Won't say what.
rumor: The black trenchcoat? Paradox hunter. Rogue. Dangerous. My target? Or competition?
Tempus? Conductor? He sees everything. Says nothing. Smart.
The twins? They saw my target. Yesterday. Or tomorrow. Unclear.
Ironchef? He's cooking with temporal ingredients. Minor violations. Not my jurisdiction.
Obsidian's corporate spy? Slate? Time Corps rejected him. Too... corporate.
dialog.quest_hook: Target's close. But I need... backup. Temporal anchor. Someone grounded. Someone like you?
dialog.quest_active: Still hunting. Target's clever. Jumping. Small hops. Hard to track.
dialog.quest_complete: Got them! Temporal fugitive apprehended! With your help! Here - time stabilizer. Prevents paradox sickness.
farewell: Watch your step. Temporal and literal.
Don't change the past. Or do. I've seen both outcomes.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning. In this timezone. Target could be anywhen.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. Peak activity. Good for cover. Bad for tracking.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Shadows lengthen. Time stretches. Interesting.
dialog.time_night: Night. Temporal currents calm. Easier to sense disturbances.
dialog.rival_mention: The black trenchcoat? Paradox hunter. We were partners. Once. Before... the Incident.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The anchor. Reliable. Grounded. Need more like you.

party_reactions.kade: Time agents. Paradox hunters. This is getting VERY complicated.
party_reactions.nix7: Temporal displacement technology: Advanced. Agent psychological state: Stressed. Mission: Critical.
party_reactions.twist: You're a TIME DETECTIVE?! That's the COOLEST THING EVER!
party_reactions.korr: He fights to preserve order. Across time itself. Respectable.
party_reactions.renna: Time magic is... dangerous. He's skilled. Or lucky. Or both.
party_reactions.suresh: He creates suffering by preserving timeline. Necessary suffering. Complex karma.
party_reactions.sova: I'd work with him. Interesting missions. Good cause.
party_reactions.grit: Special ops. Temporal theater. Same mindset. Different battlefield.
party_reactions.ashka: He moves through time like I through shadow. With purpose.
party_reactions.senna: He knows the future. Won't share. Frustrating. Understandable.

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Recognized. You're... stable. In multiple timelines. Rare.
relationship_dialog.friend: Reliable. Grounded. I'd trust you with temporal coordinates.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've saved my mission. Maybe my life. Here - time corps badge. Temporary agent status.

mini_quest.title: The Time Fugitive
mini_quest.description: Help Agent Yesterday track and apprehend a temporal fugitive

stages.hook: Target's close. Paradox jumper. Clever. I need an anchor. Someone temporal-grounded. Help me catch them?
stages.active: They're hopping. Small jumps. Station to station. Watch for anomalies. Displaced objects. Déjà vu.
stages.complete: Apprehended! Timeline stabilized! Your help was... essential. Here. Time stabilizer. Prevents paradox sickness. For you.

cross_npc_connections: trenchcoat_black_chrono: My... former partner. Paradox hunter. Now rogue. Dangerous.
trenchcoat_gray_obsidian: Slate. Corporate spy. Time Corps rejected him. Lucky him.
conductor_chrono: Tempus. Sees everything. Says nothing. Useful. Frustrating.
twins_chrono: Oracles. They saw my target. Gave... cryptic hints.
